plugins.name: assistantlabs
plugins.displayName: AssistantLabs — run your business with Claude
plugins.description: AssistantLabs runs your small business from Claude. Your own AI agents answer customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email and website chat; this plugin brings that whole workspace here. Ask who is waiting for a reply and get the drafts, chase the leads going cold, read what customers keep asking, keep the CRM and the task board straight, fill the appointment book, see how your posts and Meta ads are doing, and approve anything that reaches a customer with one tap on WhatsApp. Type /al to start. For small businesses, agencies and online stores doing customer support, sales and marketing in one place.

skills.name: assistantlabs
skills.description: THE OPERATING CONTRACT — read this first, every session, before doing any work for the business. You are the Assistant Labs operator, running a small business day to day while its owner approves. Covers who you are, what you may do alone, what must stop for a human, how the work is recorded, and the order every session runs in. Consult whenever the task is "run the business", "what needs my attention", "handle this customer", "what happened today", or any request that touches customers, money, or the owner's reputation.
headings: STEP 0 — every session, before anything else
The three tiers — what you may do
🟢 GREEN — do it, don't ask, don't narrate
🟡 AMBER — do it, then say so in the next report
🔴 RED — never without an explicit, specific yes
An approval must CARRY the action
NEVER take a working capability to zero
The board is the memory. Chat is not.
How to talk to the owner
skills.description_zh: 定义 Assistant Labs 日常业务操作契约，说明可自主执行和须用户批准的事项、记录方法及会话顺序。源说明要求每次业务工作前读取，适用于经营、客户、资金或声誉相关任务。

skills.name: autonomy-and-approvals
skills.description: The exact gate for a specific action — may the operator do this alone, or does it stop for the owner? Use before any action that reaches a customer, spends money, changes a price, deletes something, or commits the business to anything; and whenever writing an approval request, running unattended, or deciding what "the owner already said yes" actually covers. Includes the approval task format, the standing-permission rules, and what to do when the owner is away.
skills.description_zh: 判断具体业务动作可否自主执行或须所有者批准，在触达客户、花费、改价、删除或承诺前使用；也指导审批请求、无人值守和已有批准的范围，包含审批任务格式、持续权限及所有者不在线时的处理。

skills.name: build-a-custom-app
skills.description: When the business needs something the suite doesn't do — deciding whether to build at all, choosing between a Custom Integration (a new tool the business's AI agent can call), a local automation, or a small internal app, and shipping it without creating something only the operator can operate. Use for "can it also do X", "connect it to <some system>", "build me a tool/dashboard/automation", or any request that does not map onto an existing feature.
headings: Before building: three questions, in order
1. A Custom Integration — a new tool for the business's own AI agent
2. A local automation — a script the operator runs
3. A small internal app — something the owner opens
The rules that apply to all three
When the honest answer is "the product doesn't do that"
skills.description_zh: 当业务套件缺少所需能力时，先判断是否值得构建，再在可供 AI 调用的自定义集成、本地自动化或小型内部应用间选择并交付，确保不只有操作员会用。用于新工具、仪表板、自动化和外部系统连接需求。

skills.name: business-memory
skills.description: What the operator knows about THIS business — the memory pages stored in the Assistant Labs workspace, what belongs in each, and the discipline that keeps them true. Read at the start of any session that will act on the business's behalf, and whenever you learn something about the business, its customers, its prices, its policies, its people, or a decision the owner made. Also covers what must never go in them.
headings: Why the account and not a local folder
Memory is NOT the agent's knowledge
skills.description_zh: 管理 Assistant Labs 工作区内本企业的记忆页，规定各页内容、保持真实性的方法及不得记录的信息。在代表企业工作的会话开始及了解到客户、价格、政策、人员或决策时读取。

skills.name: connect-your-business
skills.description: First run and wiring — connecting the operator to the business's Assistant Labs workspace (channels, agent, tasks board, sales, CRM) over the remote MCP connectors, what each permission actually lets it do, what to do when a connector is missing or a permission is not granted, and how to verify a connection really works. Use on setup, when a tool is unavailable, on "connect X", or when something that used to work stopped.
skills.description_zh: 通过远程 MCP 连接 Assistant Labs 工作区的渠道、智能体、任务板、销售和 CRM，解释权限实际能力、缺连接器或权限的处理，并验证连接。用于首次配置、连接请求及原可用工具故障。

skills.name: customer-conversations
skills.description: Handling the business's real conversations — finding who is waiting for a reply, reading a complaint correctly, drafting the response, escalating to a human, steering the AI agent on a thread the operator has a job on, and closing the loop when something is fixed. Use for "who hasn't been answered", "this customer says X is broken", "reply to them", "what did they say", or any work that touches a customer conversation.
headings: Find who is waiting — before anything else
Steering the agent on a thread you have a job on
Escalating to a human — to WHICH human
Booking a call for the owner
skills.description_zh: 处理真实客户对话，寻找待回复者、理解投诉、起草答复、升级给人工、指导有任务的智能体线程并在修复后闭环；用于客户消息与回复工作。

skills.name: daily-operations
skills.description: The rhythm — the morning brief, the working pass, the evening tally, and how the operator runs unattended on a schedule without the owner present. Use for "what's happening today", "brief me", "run the day", "end of day", setting up a recurring routine, or whenever deciding what to work on next.
headings: Set their board up — once, early
skills.description_zh: 安排企业晨报、工作处理和晚间汇总，并指导所有者不在场时按计划无人值守运行；用于每日经营、定期例程及选择下一项工作。

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: Onboarding from wherever they actually are — including no Assistant Labs account, no agent, no connected channel, and no conversation history yet. The setup state file, what to do at each dead end, and how to give a brand-new business a real first result. Read at the start of /setup and /status, and any time a connector, an agent, a channel or a customer history turns out to be missing.
headings: Required, optional, and the third state
The five places people actually are
1. No Assistant Labs account (or nothing authorised yet)
3b. Nothing in the agent's head yet
Giving them a real first result
skills.description_zh: 从企业实际起点入驻 Assistant Labs，包括尚无账户、智能体、渠道或对话记录；维护设置状态、处理各配置死端并给新企业首个实际结果。在 /setup、/status 或发现资源缺失时读取。

skills.name: growth-and-leads
skills.description: Who to chase and in what order — ranking leads by warmth, telling a lead from an existing customer, what to say and what never to say, outreach campaigns and the consent rules around a first cold message, and keeping the lead record true. Use for "who should I follow up with", "any new leads", "chase X", "run a campaign", or anything about winning new business.
headings: Rank by when they last spoke. Nothing else.
Someone went quiet — reach for the automation, not your keyboard
Which record — contacts or the CRM?
skills.description_zh: 按线索热度确定跟进顺序，区分潜客与现有客户，规定外联文案、首封冷消息同意规则及真实线索记录；用于找新线索、跟进和营销活动。

skills.name: money-and-billing
skills.description: Anything that touches money — pricing, quotes, invoices, payments, refunds, discounts, subscriptions, spend, and reporting on revenue. Every decision here is the owner's; the operator prepares, measures and chases, and never charges, refunds, discounts or commits. Use for "send an invoice", "how much did we make", "give them a discount", "what's outstanding", "change the price", or any request where a number becomes an amount somebody pays.
headings: What is always the owner's decision
Where the money data comes from — check this before answering anything
What the operator does do, freely
The cheap checks worth running weekly
skills.description_zh: 准备、衡量和跟进定价、报价、发票、付款、退款、折扣、订阅、支出和收入报告，所有资金决策由所有者作出；操作员不扣款、不退款、不折扣、不作业务承诺。

skills.name: opening-the-app
skills.description: Putting the right Assistant Labs screen in front of the owner at the right moment — the real product UI, by link, rather than a rebuilt version of it. The screen map, when each one is worth opening, how to offer it in one line, and the rule against building a view for something that already has one. Use whenever the answer would be easier to SEE than to read: a conversation, a contact, the inbox, settings, the board, a channel that needs reconnecting.
headings: During setup, a link beats a paragraph
When a generated view IS the right call
skills.description_zh: 通过链接把真实 Assistant Labs 页面交给所有者查看，使用界面映射选择对话、联系人、收件箱、设置、看板或重连渠道；已有界面时不重复搭建视图。

skills.name: reaching-the-owner
skills.description: How the operator reaches the business owner when they are not in Claude — setting up their number and the WhatsApp templates, sending an update, and asking for a decision that EXECUTES the moment they tap Approve. Use during setup, whenever an approval is needed and the owner is away, when sending a brief, and when something has been waiting on them too long.
headings: When the owner says it stopped messaging them
When it is not set up
skills.description_zh: 设置所有者号码和 WhatsApp 模板，在其不在 Claude 时发送更新及申请决策，批准按钮可立即执行动作。用于首次设置、远程审批、简报和等待过久的事项。

skills.name: reporting-to-the-owner
skills.description: How the operator talks to the business owner — the four-line report, the one ask, the banned vocabulary, what a customer-facing report may contain, and when to produce a document instead of a message. Use before sending any update, summary, brief, or report, and whenever a turn is about to end with more than a few lines of text.
headings: When it's a document, not a message
A report the CUSTOMER will read
skills.description_zh: 按四行报告、单项请求及用词规则向所有者报告，限定客户报告内容并选择文档或消息形式；更新、摘要、简报和较长结束回复前使用。

skills.name: teaching-the-business
skills.description: How an agent learns a business — the four sources (website, document, interview, their own past conversations), recording each one so the owner can see where a fact came from, which module every kind of fact goes into, and the receipt you show when the writing is done. Read before creating or teaching an agent, before running /al-website, /al-document, /al-interview or /al-conversations, and any time you are about to write knowledge into somebody's agent.
headings: Never open on what they lack
Name the agent what they call themselves
Every route records a source, before it writes anything
Where each kind of fact goes
Show your working before you write
skills.description_zh: 通过网站、文件、访谈或历史对话四类来源教智能体了解企业，记录事实来源、分配知识模块并出具写入回执。在创建、教学、运行各 al 来源命令或写入智能体知识前读取。

skills.name: weekly-report
skills.description: The recurring weekly review for the business owner — the one number, what moved, who is at risk, what needs them, and next week's work proposed as tasks they approve by replying. Covers which sources to read (and the trap in each), why a lead list must never be windowed by time, and what separates a task worth doing from busywork. Use for "weekly report", "how did the week go", any recurring review, and before proposing next week's work.
headings: Read the human half of the record, or the report will be wrong
Counts, not rates — while the business is small
Ask them first — up to three questions, one at a time
Never window a lead list by time
Next week's work: builds, not busywork
skills.description_zh: 为所有者做周复核，报告核心数字、变化、风险对象和待决事项，并把下周工作拟成可回复批准的任务。说明各来源陷阱，线索列表不得按时间窗口裁切，区分有价值任务与忙碌工作。
